cards.title: What Finance covers across enterprise operations
cards.body:
Finance maintains the General Ledger, accounting books, and statutory tax determinations.
It oversees the supplier payment lifecycle from invoice receipt to final bank disbursement.
The module ensures financial statements, asset valuations, and tax returns remain compliant.

cards.title: Supplier payment flow from invoice booking to voucher disbursement
cards.body:
Supplier invoices are entered into the system and matched against verified warehouse receipts.
Accounts officers generate payment requests that prioritize obligations by contractual due dates.
Treasury issues payment advice notes and releases payment vouchers to settle liabilities.

cards.title: Chart of Accounts structure and finance master configuration
cards.body:
The Chart of Accounts establishes the classification structure for all company transactions.
Account groups categorize ledger heads into assets, liabilities, income, and operational expenses.
Finance books maintain independent fiscal calendars and opening balances for legal reporting.

cards.title: Automated tax determination and statutory concession handling
cards.body:
Tax and charge rules evaluate invoice lines to calculate central and state goods taxes.
Rules match supplier locations against destination company sites to assign correct rates.
Statutory concession certificates are validated to ensure compliance with governmental regulations.

cards.title: Account Determination Rules link business transactions to ledgers
cards.body:
Account Determination Rules map business operational events directly to ledger accounts.
Rules determine which asset or expense account updates when stores receive stock.
This automation removes manual account selection and prevents posting discrepancies across modules.

cards.title: Where Finance connects with Material Management
cards.body:
Finance receives valued inward delivery records generated by storekeepers upon receipt.
Accounts teams match incoming vendor bills against these confirmed delivery quantities.
Supplier advances recorded in Finance are reconciled against purchase orders to clear prepayments.

cards.title: Cash and banking journals for daily liquidity management
cards.body:
Bank journals record incoming client transfers, vendor payments, and bank service charges.
Cash journals capture petty cash disbursements, imprest replenishments, and direct receipts.
Reconciliation features verify bank statements against ledger entries to identify unpresented cheques.

cards.title: Fixed asset capitalization and periodic depreciation accounting
cards.body:
Capital purchases transition from clearing accounts into recognized fixed asset registers.
Depreciation runs calculate monthly asset wear based on corporate and tax depreciation rules.
Asset disposals and retirements calculate gain or loss on sale to maintain balance sheet accuracy.
